title: 3-Year Treasury Note auction
source: EST: three Treasury primaries now agree, including the offering amount. Treasury's own offering announcement A_20260903_3.pdf (embargoed until 11:00 A.M. 2026-09-03, PDF text layer read direct 2026-09-04) prints Offering Amount $58,000,000,000, CUSIP 91282CRL7, Currently Outstanding $0, auction 2026-09-08, issue 2026-09-15, maturity 2029-09-15, competitive close 1:00 p.m. ET. Both structured feeds have since populated the same figure and were re-fetched direct on 2026-09-07: treasurydirect.gov TA_WS/securities/upcoming (offeringAmount 58000000000, reopening No, updatedTimestamp 2026-09-03T11:08:45) and fiscaldata.treasury.gov upcoming_auctions (offering_amt 58000000000). This is the ninth consecutive $58B 3-Year new issue, matching the 2026-08-05 quarterly refunding statement (sb0590), which guides to unchanged nominal coupon sizes 'for at least the next several quarters'. Filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit, not for want of evidence. Previously re-checked 2026-09-03 at 00:32 ET (before that day's announcement, offering_amt still null) and 2026-09-01, after both endpoints were unreachable/stale on 2026-08-29
notes: Front-end supply opening the September coupon block (3Y 09-08 → 10Y 09-09 → 30Y 09-10). Newly relevant because Warsh's 2026-08-28 keynote pushed the hawkish repricing almost entirely into the front end (2Y +6-9bp, Sep hike odds ~35%->56-59%) while the long end held — this is the first coupon auction to price that risk. Discovered during the treasury-20y-bond-2026-09-15 pulse-check adjacency sweep.
